en.text: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

zhSimplified.text: 「人子啊，你要面向亚扪人说预言，攻击他们，

zhTraditional.text: 「人子啊，你要面向亞捫人說預言，攻擊他們，

en.text: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,

zhSimplified.text: 说：你们当听主耶和华的话。主耶和华如此说：我的圣所被亵渎，以色列地变荒凉，犹大家被掳掠；那时，你便因这些事说：『阿哈！』

zhTraditional.text: 說：你們當聽主耶和華的話。主耶和華如此說：我的聖所被褻瀆，以色列地變荒涼，猶大家被擄掠；那時，你便因這些事說：『阿哈！』

en.text: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.

zhSimplified.text: 所以我必将你的地交给东方人为业；他们必在你的地上安营居住，吃你的果子，喝你的奶。

zhTraditional.text: 所以我必將你的地交給東方人為業；他們必在你的地上安營居住，吃你的果子，喝你的奶。

en.text: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”

zhSimplified.text: 我必使拉巴为骆驼场，使亚扪人的地为羊群躺卧之处，你们就知道我是耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 我必使拉巴為駱駝場，使亞捫人的地為羊群躺臥之處，你們就知道我是耶和華。」

en.text: For the Lord GOD says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,

zhSimplified.text: 主耶和华如此说：「因你拍手顿足，以满心的恨恶向以色列地欢喜，

zhTraditional.text: 主耶和華如此說：「因你拍手頓足，以滿心的恨惡向以色列地歡喜，

en.text: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以我伸手攻击你，将你交给列国作为掳物。我必从万民中剪除你，使你从万国中败亡。我必除灭你，你就知道我是耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 所以我伸手攻擊你，將你交給列國作為擄物。我必從萬民中剪除你，使你從萬國中敗亡。我必除滅你，你就知道我是耶和華。」

en.text: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’

zhSimplified.text: 主耶和华如此说：「因摩押和西珥人说：『看哪，犹大家与列国无异』，

zhTraditional.text: 主耶和華如此說：「因摩押和西珥人說：『看哪，猶大家與列國無異』，

en.text: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

zhSimplified.text: 所以我要破开摩押边界上的城邑，就是摩押人看为本国之荣耀的伯·耶西末、巴力·免、基列亭，

zhTraditional.text: 所以我要破開摩押邊界上的城邑，就是摩押人看為本國之榮耀的伯‧耶西末、巴力‧免、基列亭，

en.text: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 好使东方人来攻击亚扪人。我必将亚扪人之地交给他们为业，使亚扪人在列国中不再被记念。

zhTraditional.text: 好使東方人來攻擊亞捫人。我必將亞捫人之地交給他們為業，使亞捫人在列國中不再被記念。

en.text: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”

zhSimplified.text: 我必向摩押施行审判，他们就知道我是耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 我必向摩押施行審判，他們就知道我是耶和華。」

en.text: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”

zhSimplified.text: 主耶和华如此说：「因为以东报仇雪恨，攻击犹大家，向他们报仇，大大有罪，

zhTraditional.text: 主耶和華如此說：「因為以東報仇雪恨，攻擊猶大家，向他們報仇，大大有罪，

en.text: therefore the Lord GOD says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.

zhSimplified.text: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必伸手攻击以东，剪除人与牲畜，使以东从提幔起，人必倒在刀下，地要变为荒凉，直到底但。

zhTraditional.text: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必伸手攻擊以東，剪除人與牲畜，使以東從提幔起，人必倒在刀下，地要變為荒涼，直到底但。

en.text: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord GOD.

zhSimplified.text: 我必借我民以色列的手报复以东；以色列民必照我的怒气，按我的忿怒在以东施报，以东人就知道是我施报。这是主耶和华说的。」

zhTraditional.text: 我必藉我民以色列的手報復以東；以色列民必照我的怒氣，按我的忿怒在以東施報，以東人就知道是我施報。這是主耶和華說的。」

en.text: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”

zhSimplified.text: 主耶和华如此说：「因非利士人向犹大人报仇，就是以恨恶的心报仇雪恨，永怀仇恨，要毁灭他们，

zhTraditional.text: 主耶和華如此說：「因非利士人向猶大人報仇，就是以恨惡的心報仇雪恨，永懷仇恨，要毀滅他們，

en.text: therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

zhSimplified.text: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必伸手攻击非利士人，剪除基利提人，灭绝沿海剩下的居民。

zhTraditional.text: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必伸手攻擊非利士人，剪除基利提人，滅絕沿海剩下的居民。

en.text: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”

zhSimplified.text: 我向他们大施报应，发怒斥责他们。我报复他们的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 我向他們大施報應，發怒斥責他們。我報復他們的時候，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
